faces.denNote: denominator = defender body-ticks × DT / 60; MOVING with sent-offs and with possession share — disclosed per face

usage.note: ONE row per DEFENDER per assignment pass (the TEAM_AI_INTERVAL cadence) — a DECISION distribution, not a tick distribution. Shut-arm counts are structurally zero (the ledger is untouched with the door shut), which is gate gLedgerZeroWhenShut.

perf.budgetNote: DF-C0 §R5: 2 % of the anchor tick — a BUDGET, not a self-measured share. THIS IS A WALL MEASUREMENT taken inside the instrumented walk loop (the instrument itself is inside the timer), so it is an UPPER BOUND on the seam's cost, never the engine's own profiler number, and it is published as armed-MINUS-shut with that label attached (the flip-oracle lesson: instrument cost must never masquerade as seam cost).
